subject: Req shelf prioritization — emergency backfill & rapid approval path
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Req shelf prioritization — emergency backfill & rapid approval path

Morning team,

QBR prep note — two quick operational asks we should decide on today so Talent and Procurement can act:

1) Emergency backfill: Senior Infra Engineer (open since last week due to unexpected departure). This is a Band A role that directly supports Dedicated capacity SREs; service impact if left open >3 weeks.
2) Role-shelf prioritization: I attached the QBR headcount matrix and highlighted three roles we think are mission-critical for the next quarter. I propose we approve an expedited approval path for Band A "service continuity" roles: recruiter engagement within 48 hours, expedited finance sign-off, and a 10-business-day interview-to-offer target.

Requested decisions:
- Lauren: confirm we can pull from contingency pool or provide headcount code.
- Marissa: confirm Procurement can run an accelerated vendor/recruiter engagement (Rivet) and whether we need a PO before offer.
- Markus: leadership sign-off on the expedited path and any guardrails (salary cap / interview panel).

Attachments: qbr_headcount_matrix.xlsx (tabs: "QBR_highlights", "Banding_recs", "cost_impact")
Drive doc with requested MOS snippets and process notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRHeadcountMatrix
HubSpot record for open reqs: HubSpot: hs-48271

If we can lock this today I will ask Talent to immediately open recruiter kickoff and draft short MOS.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
VP, Platform & Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Dave Lin <dave@rivetpartners.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Req shelf prioritization — emergency backfill & rapid approval path

Jordan —

I support the expedited approach for Band A service continuity roles. From Procurement's side (looping in Dave), we can run an accelerated recruiter engagement with Rivet Partners. Two notes:

- We can start conversations before a PO but offers will require a PO/finance code to be issued for agency placements.
- If Talent can route candidate submittals through our preferred vendor flow and keep the initial interviews to a single technical + hiring manager round, we should hit the 10-business-day target.

Action: Dave, please share the minimal vendor intake form and the fastest PO workflow. Jordan — please confirm which specific requisitions to prioritize (req titles or ad-hoc IDs).

-Marissa
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Req shelf prioritization — emergency backfill & rapid approval path

Thanks — quick confirmations and next steps from Talent:

1) Contingency pool: I can route one headcount from the contingency pool to this Senior Infra Engineer immediately (code: HC-CTG-04). That should cover the initial agency fee cap.
2) MOS / JD: I took Jordan's highlighted row in the matrix and drafted a short MOS. Attached: MOS_template.md (please use tab "QBR_highlights" as the source).
3) Recruiter kickoff: I'll ask Talent to schedule a 30-minute kickoff with Rivet and the hiring manager today if Procurement confirms intake form.

Requirements for the expedited flow:
- Hiring manager to provide a 30-minute interview window within 48 hours of candidate submittal
- Interview slate limited to two rounds initially (tech + hiring manager) with optional short take-home for senior candidates
- Salary alignment cap: please keep offers within the published band A midpoint + 10% (unless Markus approves).

I'll update HubSpot record HS-48271 with the MOS and put a note on the req so Talent can track SLA. Target: first slate in <10 business days.

-Lauren
Head of Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Req shelf prioritization — emergency backfill & rapid approval path

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Leadership decision: approved.

Guardrails and notes:
- Approved: expedited approval path for Band A service continuity roles (as outlined). This covers Senior Infra Engineer (highlighted in QBR_highlights).
- Finance commitment: I authorize up to $45k in total onboarding and agency fees from the contingency pool for this hire; anything above requires explicit sign-off.
- Salary cap: adhere to Lauren's banding guidance (midpoint +10%); exceptions routed to me via email with clear justification.
- Timeline: Talent and Procurement should execute recruiter kickoff today; hiring manager to prioritize interview windows.

Please consider this the formal sign-off. Jordan, flag if you want me to join the kickoff with Rivet to accelerate decisions.

-Markus
VP, Engineering Ops (interim Head of Platform)
Redwood Inference
